_meta: Gate 1 flow-rewire map — semantic testIDs generated by maestro/tools/add-testids.cjs, per-screen lists in testid-map.json (derived from disk). Verify before trusting in a flow. Entries marked *(text)* are deliberate text-selector retainers (G-02 remainder or OS surface) — see the flow header for the reason. PASS 2 (2026-10-03) corrected three entries that pointed at screens nothing routes to, and removed the wrong 'role chips have no testID' claim.

auth.login.roleChips: N/A — login.tsx has no role chips; they live on phone-entry (see auth.phone-entry). PASS 2 corrected this: the old '(text) e2e copy, no testID' claim was wrong.

customer.home.destinationRow: customer.home.el-2 (*live* 'Where to?' row — label home.search_destination is 'Where to?', NOT 'Search destination...')
customer.home.nextButton: customer.home.handle-next (renders rider_home.next = 'Next'; the old 'Find now' label is gone)
customer.home.promoChip: customer.home.set-selected-promo (filter by description — the apply-promos code-entry sheet is dead)
customer.home.callForRide: customer.home.handle-call-for-ride (renders rider_home.call_for_ride = 'Call for Ride'; the old 'Request Ride' label is gone)

customer.rate-driver.notes.reachability: LIVE — routed from user-arrived, ride-tracking, activity-completed

DEAD.customer.find-ride.*: DELETED 2026-10-03 (owner call). Proven unreachable first: zero inbound router.push/replace/href anywhere in app/, and not registered as a Tabs/Stack.Screen child in any _layout.tsx. app/(main)/(customer)/find-ride/ no longer exists (650 lines, 8 testIDs). Its booking sheet was absorbed into (tabs)/home/index.tsx (bookingStep LOCATIONS->FARES); flows were repointed to customer.home.* in 8e6e282. Static reachability cannot be gated on (see the header in flow-xcheck.cjs), so if this screen returns, a flow must not select customer.find-ride.* on the assumption that it exists.
DEAD.customer.confirm-ride.*: DELETED 2026-10-03 (owner call). Proven unreachable first: zero inbound router.push/replace/href anywhere in app/, and not registered as a Tabs/Stack.Screen child in any _layout.tsx. app/(main)/(customer)/confirm-ride/ no longer exists (757 lines, 12 testIDs). It also owned the ONLY schedule-for-later toggle in the tree, which left rider/booking/05-scheduled-ride.yaml blocked (B-3). RESOLVED 2026-10-04 — the feature was ruled BUILD (server-complete: POST /api/ride/schedule + scheduler promotion; full schedule screen at app/(main)/(customer)/schedule-ride/), and the affordance was rebuilt on the live booking sheet as customer.home.push-schedule-ride; the flow was rebuilt and unblocked the same day. Its i18n keys remain in en/common.json and are now orphaned — the whole confirm_ride.* block (58 keys). The schedule_ride.* block is NOT orphaned (schedule-ride screen + ScheduleRideSheet render it).
DEAD.customer.apply-promos.*: DELETED 2026-10-03 (owner call). Proven unreachable first: zero inbound router.push/replace/href anywhere in app/, and not registered as a Tabs/Stack.Screen child in any _layout.tsx. app/(main)/(customer)/apply-promos/ no longer exists (220 lines, 5 testIDs). Discounts are inline chips on the home sheet instead (customer.home.set-selected-promo).
DEAD.customer.schedule-ride.*: LIVE — two inbound routes as of 2026-10-04: (a) the home booking sheet's 'Schedule for later' affordance (customer.home.push-schedule-ride, added when B-3 was resolved BUILD) and (b) no-drivers-available/index.tsx:53 (id customer.no-drivers-available.push-schedule-ride), i.e. post-failure recovery only. The schedule screen reads pickup/destination from useCustomer() and vehicle from useRiderStore(), the same stores the home sheet writes, so the booking-sheet selection carries over. Its flow (rider/booking/05-scheduled-ride.yaml) was rebuilt and unblocked the same day.

rider.enter-otp.pinField: rider.enter-otp.set-pin (added PASS 2 — forwarded by components/PinInput.tsx onto the invisible TextInput that actually receives keystrokes)

rider.finish-ride.backHomeButton: rider.finish-ride.handle-go-home (NOTE: 'Browse Home' in flows was stale copy; the rendered label is finish_ride.back_to_home)

rider.onboarding._steps: 7-step wizard (STEP_TITLES, onboarding/index.tsx:124) — 1 Profile, 2 Vehicle, 3 Vehicle Documents, 4 Driver Documents, 5 Rideshare Experience, 6 Payout, 7 Review & Consent. Step ground = the title literal: the progress header renders `Step ${step} of 7 — ${STEP_TITLES[step-1]}` (L1093), so 'Step 3 of 7' is interpolated, exists in no source file, and cannot be corpus-checked.
rider.onboarding.footerCta: rider.onboarding.go-next (one control for all steps; label 'Continue' until step 7, 'Submit' on it — L1429)
rider.onboarding.step1Name: rider.onboarding.set-name (the only step1Valid requirement: name non-empty)
rider.onboarding.step2BodyType: rider.onboarding.set-body-type-modal-visible -> modal rows rider.onboarding.on-select-2 (OptionPickerModal uses on-select; BodyTypePickerModal uses on-select-2)
rider.onboarding.step2BrandPicker: rider.onboarding.set-picker-modal -> rows rider.onboarding.on-select. The LAST row is 'Others' (L1460) — picking it swaps the list for the free-text field. This is what makes step 2 deterministic: brand/model options otherwise come from the vehicle-models API, and resolvedBrand/resolvedModel (L668) fall back to the typed text.
rider.onboarding.step2ModelText: rider.onboarding.set-model-text — revealed automatically once brand === 'Others' (L1172), so the model picker is never opened
rider.onboarding.step2Skip: rider.onboarding.skip-vehicle-step — CONDITIONAL: renders only when me?.vehicle_id != null (L1289). A fresh registration never sees it, so do not build a flow that depends on it.
rider.onboarding.uploadCards: rider.onboarding.upload-<key> — step 3 (all required): reg-scan-front, reg-scan-back, brta-certificate, vehicle-photo-front, vehicle-photo-left, vehicle-photo-back, vehicle-photo-right. Step 4 (all required): nid-front, nid-back, license-front, license-back. Cards are UNROLLED in JSX rather than .map-ed because testid-manifest records only string-literal testID attributes. Post-upload state text = 'Tap to replace document'. Opening a card launches the Android photo picker (manual).
rider.onboarding.step5: rider.onboarding.set-legacy-answer (repeated Yes/No). step5Valid is hardcoded `true` (L710); answering 'No' keeps the 4 optional legacy cards hidden.
rider.onboarding.consentRow: rider.onboarding.set-consent (4 rows, tap by index 0-3; step7Valid = every true)
rider.onboarding.landing: finishOnboarding() POSTs documents then router.replace('(main)/(rider)/verification'); assert rider.verification.handle-refresh. There is NO success alert — the old 'Documents Submitted' + tapOn OK tail was dead on both counts.
